title: Using Workspace (SAO inside IST)
body: Workspace embeds GNU Health SAO under a single IST top header at /workspace (edge-to-edge iframe). The IST left sidebar stays hidden; use SAO’s own left menu inside the frame for navigation. The SAO top bar (wordmark, Action, Administrator, SAO logout) is hidden when embedded — Help and Sign out live only in the IST header. Use Workspace for Tryton wizards and deep screens not yet mirrored in React (CoA, fiscal years, lab create-test, invoice post/pay, module upgrade apply). Open from Favorites → Workspace, or any “Open in Workspace” button (Setup Hub, Financial, Companies, Model browser). Same-origin only: SAO loads from /sao/ on this host. Sign-in: use IST login first; if SAO asks for credentials again inside the frame, sign in with the same Tryton user. Theming: SAO uses IST navy/gold via custom.css on the server. See also Setup Hub order and financial checklist. Related: SAO_EMBED_AND_SCREEN_PARITY.md.
steps: Open Favorites → Workspace, or click Open in Workspace on a stub page.
Use SAO’s left menu inside the iframe to open wizards and deep screens.
Complete the SAO wizard or form inside the embedded client.
Return to React routes (Patients, Appointments, …) for daily list/create screens via the IST logo or Favorites.
